'''Henck''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who lived during the [[Third Galactic War]].<ref name="Schematic Aspirations" /> By [[3624 BBY]],<ref name="Date" /> Henck was a [[Security officer/Legends|security officer]] for the [[Mantellian Separatist Movement]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ord Mantell/Legends|Ord Mantell]]. He was present at [[Port Granost]] when he was [[Death/Legends|killed]] by the [[Alliance Commander]].<ref name="Schematic Aspirations" />
